scope: Synthetic owned fixture, one Apple Silicon Mac. No arbitrary-application or hard real-time guarantee.
clock: External monotonic time includes Python CLI startup, UDS request, native action and actual final-state verification.
allocation: Latest live run used an explicitly authorized inactive experiment Desktop. Auto allocation correctly refused earlier because no empty inactive Desktop existed. Auto reservation also has fake-backend regressions.
creation_findings: Plain ordinary windows inherited the prebound process Space.
An inactive default NSPanel initially had no Space; revealing was blocked at alpha zero.
A floating NSPanel then joined all Spaces; revealing was again blocked at alpha zero.
Explicit Managed collection behavior allowed the owned NSPanel to verify a single Space before reveal.
The v4 mixed ordinary-window/panel stress run later observed foreground/active-Space changes. Cause remains under investigation.

A later bounded v5 run with real-time Process Manager foreground metadata, context-change stop guards, and own-app event-type auditing completed 100 actions without observed focus/Space changes. This does not establish the cause of v4 changes.
